title: Stream Events
description: Sequential data stream chunks for reliable transport over MQTT (e.g. PCAP traces, firmware blobs, reliable alarms, logs playback).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the stream chunk event was generated

session_id.description: Unique session identifier for the continuous stream transmission

event_no.description: Sequence number for this stream event to support reliable sequential delivery and reassembly

chunk_index.description: 0-based index of the transmitted chunk payload within the total session

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks comprising the complete transmission binary
